name: q
description: Q — DJ request queue with crowd portal and Rekordbox library sync

scripts.predev:stack: node -e "const [maj]=process.versions.node.split('.'); if (+maj<18) { console.error('Need Node 18+. Run: node --version'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -n api,crowd,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:crowd" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start:web: npm run build -w @q/web && npm run preview -w @q/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @q/shared && npm run build -w @q/rekordbox && npm run build -w @q/serato && npm run build -w @q/api && npm run build -w @q/crowd && npm run build -w @q/web
